identity description: A retro wind-up tin toy robot. Boxy pale teal-blue body, square head with two round eyes and a small mouth grille, small orange antenna ball on top, round gauge dial on the chest with tick marks only, three small round buttons (red, yellow, green), a brass wind-up key on its side, chunky orange-red feet, short arms with simple claw hands.
A classic folded paper airplane made of cream paper, seen from three-quarters above with one folded wing raised, a single soft blue stripe along one wing, crisp triangular folds and a pointed nose.
A round red wooden yo-yo with a wide cream stripe around its middle, two shallow domed halves, a brass axle, and a cream string ending in a small loop above it.
A chubby yellow rubber bath duck wearing a tiny white sailor hat with a blue band, orange beak, round black eyes, sitting in a small puff of white soap bubbles.
A chunky green wind-up toy frog crouched on its back legs, big round eyes on top of its head, a lighter cream-green belly, and a small brass wind-up key sticking out of its side.
A diamond box kite with a red and cream checked pattern on its panels, a thin wooden cross frame visible at the edges, and a long cream tail with three small red bows.
A miniature carousel music box: a round cream and red base, a red and cream striped canopy with a small flag on top, four tiny painted horses on brass poles, and a brass finial.
A classic wooden spinning top with a wide rounded body, alternating red and brass horizontal stripes, a short brass stem and knob on top, and a narrow metal tip at the bottom.
